releases.headline: One generation, everywhere.
releases.abstract: MERIDIAN 4.3.2 completes the V4.3 synchronization by correcting stale runtime self-identification. RHEN health, FastAPI metadata, runtime provenance, Command-facing diagnostics, and the public release program now agree on the V4.3 generation while preserving all prior release snapshots unchanged.
releases.thesis: Operational identity is evidence. A production system should not run V4.3 code while reporting V3 or 0.8.2 metadata. This patch changes identity metadata only and leaves trading behavior, authority, strategy, risk, sizing, scheduler behavior, and evidence methodology unchanged.

capabilities.label: DISCOVERY
capabilities.title: Broader equity opportunity discovery
capabilities.body: RHEN uses hierarchical Alpaca market-wide screening before bounded detailed evaluation, expanding the candidate pool without pulling full history for the entire catalog each cycle.

capabilities.label: EXECUTION
capabilities.title: Regular + extended equity operation
capabilities.body: Live authority is limited to long U.S. equities and ETFs. Regular-session execution and the 24/5 extended-equity lane retain explicit session attribution, authorization, risk, and reconciliation.

capabilities.label: EVIDENCE
capabilities.title: Exact decision-to-outcome measurement
capabilities.body: New forward-evidence candidates require the original decision reference price plus completed decision-bar timestamp. Ten- and fifteen-minute outcomes mature later without rewriting the original decision.

capabilities.label: RESEARCH
capabilities.title: Shadow economics and allocation validation
capabilities.body: Cost-aware shadow economics and normalized allocation alternatives are evaluated post-event against matured outcomes while remaining unable to change the live record.

capabilities.label: CONTROL
capabilities.title: IREN registry-aware control state
capabilities.body: IREN separates runtime health from protected operator state and now reduces scheduler incidents only from workflows that remain in the canonical registry. Retired failures stay durable history instead of current degradation.

capabilities.label: STORAGE
capabilities.title: Pressure-aware bounded RHEN Core
capabilities.body: SQLite retention, reclaimable-page accounting, compaction, and analytics shedding keep storage bounded while preserving critical execution and evidence records.

architecture.title: Cloudflare public + Command edge
architecture.body: React/TypeScript public surfaces, protected Command identity, API proxying, privacy boundaries, and production delivery.

architecture.title: Canonical RHEN Railway runtime
architecture.body: One supervised application service contains execution, Core/Store, IREN control, GRAEN research, VELUM replay, NOSTRA forecast, Research Agent, and supporting internal APIs.

architecture.title: Equity execution boundary
architecture.body: Only RHEN execution can receive live broker authority, and the current authority scope is long U.S. equities and ETFs.

architecture.title: RHEN Core / SQLite
architecture.body: One bounded durable state store owns scheduler, research, incident, telemetry, and evidence state with retention and compaction.

architecture.title: Research + replay boundary
architecture.body: GRAEN, VELUM, NOSTRA, Research Agent, and shadow validators can generate evidence but cannot self-promote into live strategy or risk changes.

architecture.title: Alpaca broker + market data
architecture.body: Broker account truth, equity market state, orders, fills, positions, clock, calendar, and bounded screeners feed the production boundary.

verification.label: VERSION
verification.body: Execution provenance, API metadata, and release identity now share the same system version.

verification.label: MODULES
verification.body: RHEN, GRAEN, VELUM, NOSTRA, Research Agent, Core, and IREN processes are reachable through the unified health boundary.

limitations.title: October 6 legacy candidates are not reconstructed
limitations.body: 2,445 legacy candidates cannot be measured exactly: 1,746 lack the original decision-bar timestamp and 699 lack the original decision reference price. RHEN deliberately does not guess those values.

limitations.title: Profitability is not established
limitations.body: A functioning execution and evidence system does not prove an edge. Shadow economics, shadow allocation, and strategy changes remain gated on valid matured evidence across additional sessions.

limitations.title: Feed and market-structure limits remain explicit
limitations.body: Market-data identity, session rules, broker constraints, spreads, fills, and small-sample effects remain part of interpretation rather than being hidden by aggregate metrics.

limitations.title: First exact post-fix cohort not yet observed
limitations.body: The forward-evidence repair landed after the October 6 regular equity session. The system must still collect the first live post-fix cohort before shadow economics, allocation, or another strategy patch can be judged from exact outcomes.

limitations.title: Protected configuration review remains operator-authorized
limitations.body: IREN may correctly remain ATTENTION_REQUIRED while protected configuration identity awaits deliberate review. Runtime health does not authorize automatic acceptance or replacement of the trusted baseline.

releases.headline: Retired workflows stay historical.
releases.abstract: MERIDIAN 4.3.1 closes the final control-plane consistency gap in the V4.3 cutover. IREN now distinguishes currently registered scheduler workflows from historical durable runs, so a removed workflow can no longer keep Command degraded after the workflow has been retired.
releases.thesis: Current operational state must be reduced from current canonical authority, not from historical work that no longer exists. Durable history remains preserved, but retired scheduler failures no longer masquerade as active incidents.

releases.headline: One equity system. Exact evidence.
releases.abstract: CANONICAL establishes RHEN V4.3 as the consolidated equity-first production system: one Railway runtime, long U.S. equity and ETF authority, hierarchical market discovery, regular and extended-session operation, bounded Core storage, protected research control, and exact forward-evidence measurement.
releases.thesis: V4.3 should expand what RHEN can observe and test without expanding what it is allowed to claim. Production authority stays narrow, retired crypto research stays historical, and post-event strategy evidence is admitted only when the original decision-time inputs were actually preserved.

releases.headline: From construction to observation.
releases.abstract: AURORA marks the point where RHEN stops being primarily a system under construction and becomes a system expected to produce controlled, reconstructable live evidence. The live executor remains deterministic while evidence, reporting, research, and pre-open observation are separated into bounded layers.
releases.thesis: AURORA's first responsibility is to prove that RHEN can operate safely, leave a complete evidence trail, and distinguish operational defects from strategy outcomes.

capabilities.label: EXECUTION
capabilities.title: Guarded deterministic live trading
capabilities.body: RHEN owns production decisions, risk gates, sizing, reconciliation, order submission, and position management. Research has no production execution authority.

capabilities.label: EVIDENCE
capabilities.title: Canonical decision and outcome telemetry
capabilities.body: Runs, cycles, candidates, rejection reasons, order intents, fills, exits, incidents, provenance, forward outcomes, and MFE/MAE can be preserved for reconstruction.

capabilities.label: REPORTING
capabilities.title: Daily and weekly operating research
capabilities.body: Post-close and weekly reports expose candidate funnels, consistency warnings, evidence gaps, outcome summaries, and durable research questions.

capabilities.label: RESEARCH
capabilities.title: Research Agent proposal and freeze foundation
capabilities.body: Deterministic proposal checks, availability-only feasibility, methodology freeze, exact authorization, and protected-stage workflow controls exist without an active LLM runtime.

capabilities.label: PRE-OPEN
capabilities.title: Shadow market-state observation
capabilities.body: Pre-Open State v1 records context before the U.S. session and realized outcomes later. It is shadow-only and has no live-order authority.

capabilities.label: SAFETY
capabilities.title: Research cannot silently become production
capabilities.body: Development, validation, and holdout openings require exact durable authorization. A semantic recommendation alone cannot change experiment workflow state.

architecture.title: Broker + market data
architecture.body: Account, order, position, clock, and configured market-data state.

architecture.title: Live executor
architecture.body: Exclusive production execution, risk, sizing, reconciliation, and position authority.

architecture.title: Canonical evidence
architecture.body: Durable telemetry that can reconstruct why an opportunity was accepted, rejected, or exited.

architecture.title: Reporting
architecture.body: Daily and weekly synthesis of operating state, evidence quality, and research questions.

architecture.title: Research Agent foundation
architecture.body: Bounded experiment design and authorization infrastructure, still dormant as a runtime agent.

architecture.title: Pre-Open State v1
architecture.body: Independent shadow collection of pre-open context and later outcomes.

verification.label: SOURCE
verification.body: Canonical release source commit.

verification.label: STRATEGY
verification.body: Active live strategy identity at release freeze.

verification.label: INCIDENTS
verification.body: No unresolved operational incidents at the Sunday release freeze.

verification.label: STAGE TWO
verification.body: Focused Research Agent tests and full implementation-baseline suite reported passing.

limitations.title: Small clean live sample
limitations.body: The current architecture has not yet accumulated a long cross-session evidence history. One session cannot establish profitability or robustness.

limitations.title: IEX feed constraints
limitations.body: The configured basic equity feed is not consolidated SIP coverage. Research preserves feed identity instead of silently substituting another source.

limitations.title: Research Agent runtime not active
limitations.body: No LLM provider, research-agent Railway service, scheduler, or autonomous protected-stage opening exists in AURORA.

limitations.title: No promoted Pre-Open predictive model
limitations.body: The pre-open layer collects evidence only. No released predictive model influences live execution.
